items.why: Volatility is spiking as the sell-off continues, with investors fretting about AI, tariffs, and inflation and turning to defensive positioning.
Nvidia leads the chip rout as headlines note the return of CEO Jensen Huang failed to quell AI doubts and warn an AI wipeout could have broad consequences.
The chip rout continues as the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq sink on hot inflation and new Trump tariffs, and AMD is caught in the sector-wide slide.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures down 1.77% and Nasdaq futures down 3.04% as the chip rout continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off sharply in a tech-led slide as hot inflation, new Trump tariffs, and a continuing chip rout weigh on the market. The Nasdaq is down about 4% with chip names leading the drop and the VIX spiking as investors reach for protection.
